Searching for meaning in your twenties, what it actually is and what helps.

Feeling adrift in your twenties is common, and it is not a sign that something is wrong with you. Research suggests a period of quarter-life crisis is usual across many countries, and that having a sense of meaning is linked with better wellbeing. Searching for meaning tends to feel hardest when it comes with little sense of control, so a small, values-based step may be a more reachable place to start than waiting to feel ready.
